items.migrate_text: A device-resource generation exists (`_deviceResourceGeneration`, packages/engine/Source/Renderer/WebGPU/WebGPUContext.ts:924-928, advanced on every recovery and checked by ~337 sites), so the original 'no epoch' premise is closed. What remains is uneven adoption by async completions: the Gaussian-splat renderer's pipeline promises land unguarded after the invalidation sweep (A5-1, FIX_QUEUE_2026-08-27_AUDIT_FINDINGS.md:50), the environment singletons have no ownership contract for in-flight work (S6-ENV-DETERMINISTIC-DESTROY-DEVICE-RECOVERY, DEFERRED_WORK.md:10721), and the ~1.7 s blind window before device.lost resolves is Q-49. items.title: Canvas reconfigure race
items.claim: resize()/reconfigure call context.configure without checking for an active render pass.
items.evidence: WebGPUContext.ts:4655-4663 `resize()` -> `_applyCanvasConfig` -> WebGPUContextCanvasConfig.ts:96/:106/:122 `host._context.configure(...)`; none checks `_currentRenderPassEncoder`. Mitigation is call order: CesiumWidget.js:61/:69 resizes from the widget loop before `scene.render`, and no in-frame caller of `context.resize()` was found in Scene or Widget. No queue row.
items.migrate_text: `WebGPUContext.resize()` (packages/engine/Source/Renderer/WebGPU/WebGPUContext.ts:4655-4663) and the HDR/SDR fallback chain in WebGPUContextCanvasConfig.ts:96-122 call `context.configure()` with no guard against an open render pass or an acquired swap texture. Today this is safe only by call order — CesiumWidget.js:61/:69 resizes before `scene.render` and nothing resizes mid-frame — so the defect is latent. A one-line guard (defer the reconfigure to `endFrame` when `_currentRenderPassEncoder !== null` or `_currentTextureView` is held) would make the invariant explicit.

items.claim: GlobeTerrain.wgsl and PrimitiveMatElev*.wgsl hardcode Earth radii (with inconsistent values).
items.evidence: Globe half fixed Batch 6: GlobeTerrain.wgsl:81 `ellipsoidRadius` uniform, :826, :1380. RTE ellipsoid-awareness FEAT-3DT2-03 RESOLVED Batch 496 (FEATURE_INVENTORY.md:1025; CSM slice DEFERRED_WORK.md:9859). Still hardcoded: `WGS84_ONE_OVER_RADII` in PrimitiveMatElevBandFlat.wgsl:99-103, PrimitiveMatElevBandLit.wgsl:111-115, PrimitiveMatElevContourFlat.wgsl:84-88, PrimitiveMatElevContourLit.wgsl:116-120, PrimitiveMatElevRampFlat.wgsl:85-89 (now consistently 6378137/6356752.3, the 6371000 inconsistency is gone); `WGS84_EQUATORIAL_RADIUS` in CloudReconstructionAttachments.wgsl:48 and CloudTemporalResolve.wgsl:31. ARCHITECTURE.md:412 cites H-P7 as the live shader-side gap. No queue row owns the primitive/cloud shader constants.
items.surviving_record: ARCHITECTURE.md:412 (pointer only); FEATURE_INVENTORY.md:1025 FEAT-3DT2-03 (RTE half, resolved)
items.migrate_text: Non-WGS84 ellipsoids: the globe reads `camera.ellipsoidRadius` (GlobeTerrain.wgsl:81/:1380) and RTE is ellipsoid-aware since Batch 496 (FEAT-3DT2-03), but the elevation-material primitive shaders still bake `WGS84_ONE_OVER_RADII` (packages/engine/Source/Shaders/WebGPU/Primitive/PrimitiveMatElevBandFlat.wgsl:99-103, PrimitiveMatElevBandLit.wgsl:111-115, PrimitiveMatElevContourFlat.wgsl:84-88, PrimitiveMatElevContourLit.wgsl:116-120, PrimitiveMatElevRampFlat.wgsl:85-89) and the cloud reconstruction shaders bake `WGS84_EQUATORIAL_RADIUS` (Environment/CloudReconstructionAttachments.wgsl:48, CloudTemporalResolve.wgsl:31), where WebGL uses `czm_ellipsoidRadii`/`czm_ellipsoidInverseRadii`. items.evidence: Rebuild happens only on revision change / storage upgrade (WebGPUPointCloudRenderer.ts:1789-1803), so the per-frame premise is gone; the load-time CPU decode remains (`new Float32Array(pointCount * 10)` :1276, per-point decode in buildInstanceBuffer :1154-1290) with SOA world arrays for the GPU LOD processor (:1160-1167, WebGPUPointCloudLODProcessor.ts). The dedicated GPU LOD path already consumes SOA arrays (:1160-1167); C18-A1 (CLOD) and C18-A5 (compute point rasterization) are the rows that would move decode and residency to the GPU. No row names the load-time hitch itself.

items.title: ClippingPolygon SDF cached by polygon count only
items.claim: Revision = collection.length; vertex edits with the same count leave the SDF stale; no Earth-curvature correction.
items.evidence: WebGPUClippingPolygonCollection.ts:108-112 early-returns when `lastTotalPositions === totalPositions && lastLength === collection.length` (:197-205 record both) — count-of-positions was added, but moving a vertex without changing counts still reuses the stale SDF, and no curvature term exists. No DEFERRED_WORK/FIX_QUEUE row mentions ClippingPolygon.
items.migrate_text: `WebGPUClippingPolygonCollection` (packages/engine/Source/Renderer/WebGPU/WebGPUClippingPolygonCollection.ts:108-112) regenerates its signed-distance texture only when `collection.length` or the total position count changes, so editing a polygon's vertices in place (same counts) leaves the GPU SDF stale, and the SDF is planar with no Earth-curvature correction for polygons spanning >100 km. WebGL rebuilds from the collection's own dirty flags. Fix: key on the collection's revision/dirty state (or hash positions) and document the curvature limit; no queue row owns this.
